name: Navi
_about: Navi, after a photo of a BMW map view (Nov 14 2026), generated by tools/gen_mblade_navi.py (edit that and regenerate): a wide diagonal band on the left: the textured blue stripe is the speed (a white marker at the speed on the same scale as the Sport theme), the violet stripe is the rev counter (lit up to the rpm with marks 0..7; the hybrid rev counter of hud.js: the battery's power in light blue while it alone drives, in green while it charges, the unit and CHARGE above it), the big rounded map window with the white line under it that steps up at the right, and thin bars along the bottom: fuel with its range on the left, the hybrid battery with its electric range on the right (in place of the photo's oil temperature, which moves to the free column on the right). The stock-style shift light and the lettering are at the top. Without a map window the speed is big in the middle; with one (Waze, Cluster Centre, Cluster Info) the theme is rebuilt as the Sport theme is (backdrop_open and the o_ readouts): the window at x 534..1386, y 120..600, the band steeper and narrower on the left, the speed big on the right above BMW's black box, nothing under the map. Clear of BMW's belt light (x 587..626, y 663..700). Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
